title: WalletRecord
description: An on-chain wallet identity for a user or church participant in the BibleFi ecosystem. Captures EVM address, supported chains, wallet type, optional balance snapshot, and treasury status.

wallet_id.description: Globally unique identifier for this wallet record (UUID v4).

schema_version.description: Semantic version of the WalletRecord schema used (e.g. '1.0.0').

chain_ids.description: List of EVM chain IDs on which this wallet is active (e.g. 1 for Ethereum Mainnet, 137 for Polygon).

wallet_type.description: Classification of the wallet. 'eoa' = externally-owned account, 'multisig' = multi-signature contract, 'smart_wallet' = account-abstraction contract, 'hardware' = hardware-backed EOA.

ens_name.description: ENS domain or other human-readable name associated with this wallet (e.g. 'mychurch.eth').

label.description: User-defined label for this wallet (e.g. 'Offering wallet', 'Hot wallet').

owner_id.description: UUID of the user_profile record that owns this wallet.

church_id.description: UUID of the church_record this wallet is associated with.

balance_snapshot.description: Optional point-in-time snapshot of token balances held by this wallet.

captured_at.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp when this snapshot was taken.

tokens.description: List of token balances included in this snapshot.

contract_address.description: EVM contract address of the token. Omit for native assets.

amount.description: Raw token balance as a string to preserve precision (e.g. '1000000000000000000' for 1 ETH).

amount_usd.description: USD-equivalent value of the balance at snapshot time.

is_treasury.description: Indicates whether this wallet serves as a church treasury wallet.

verified.description: Whether this wallet address has been verified by the BibleFi platform.

tags.description: Optional free-form tags for filtering or categorisation.

created_at.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp when this wallet record was created.

updated_at.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp when this wallet record was last updated.
